title: Ticket detail
description: One ticket: status, decision, why the confidence is what it is, diagnosis, stages, evidence and history.

list.name: incident
list.label: Ticket
list.query: SELECT incident_id FROM incidents ORDER BY seq DESC
list.definition: SELECT incident_id FROM incidents ORDER BY seq DESC

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH d AS (SELECT diagnosis_json AS diagnosis_json FROM diagnoses WHERE incident_id = '$incident' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT i.status AS "Status",
  coalesce((SELECT json_extract(diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class') FROM d), '-') AS "Class",
  (SELECT coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) FROM d) AS "Confidence",
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incident_events a WHERE a.incident_id = i.incident_id AND a.kind = 'auto_approved')
       THEN 'auto · known fix'
       ELSE coalesce((SELECT CASE WHEN a.kind = 'approval:reject' THEN 'denied · ' ELSE '' END
                             || substr(a.detail, 4, instr(a.detail || ':', ':') - 4)
                      FROM incident_events a WHERE a.incident_id = i.incident_id AND a.kind LIKE 'approval:%'
                      ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1), '-') END AS "Decided by",
  CASE i.platform WHEN 'databricks' THEN 'Databricks' WHEN 'jenkins' THEN 'Jenkins' WHEN 'snowflake' THEN 'Snowflake' WHEN 'aws_glue' THEN 'AWS Glue' WHEN 'azure_data_factory' THEN 'Azure Data Factory' ELSE i.platform END || ' · ' || coalesce(i.pipeline, '?') AS "Application",
  coalesce(i.failed_task, '-') AS "Failed task",
  replace(substr(i.opened_at, 1, 16), 'T', ' ') AS "Opened (UTC)"
FROM incidents i WHERE i.incident_id = '$incident'

panels.title: Decision
panels.description: Approve / Deny a waiting fix, or Close an escalated ticket: each opens the console's confirm page.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT incident_id, max(id) AS id FROM diagnoses GROUP BY incident_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN i.status = 'awaiting_approval' AND json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.resolution.action') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Approve' ELSE '' END AS "Approve",
  CASE WHEN i.status = 'awaiting_approval' AND json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.resolution.action') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deny' ELSE '' END AS "Deny",
  CASE WHEN i.status = 'escalated' THEN 'Close' ELSE '' END AS "Close",
  CASE WHEN i.status = 'awaiting_approval' AND json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.resolution.action') IS NOT NULL THEN 'rerun_job ' || json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.resolution.action.parameters')
       WHEN i.status = 'escalated' THEN 'a person must act, then close the ticket'
       ELSE 'no decision needed (' || replace(i.status, '_', ' ') || ')' END AS "Decision",
  'Open on ' || CASE i.platform WHEN 'databricks' THEN 'Databricks' WHEN 'jenkins' THEN 'Jenkins' WHEN 'snowflake' THEN 'Snowflake' WHEN 'aws_glue' THEN 'AWS Glue' WHEN 'azure_data_factory' THEN 'Azure Data Factory' ELSE i.platform END AS "Failed run",
  'Open the trace' AS "Langfuse",
  json_extract(i.incident_json, '$.run.run_page_url') AS "run_url"
FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN latest l USING (incident_id) LEFT JOIN diagnoses d ON d.id = l.id
WHERE i.incident_id = '$incident'

panels.title: Why this confidence
panels.description: Calibrated = 0.4 × model + 0.6 × share of the four evidence checks passed. Older tickets show the score without its checks.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH d AS (SELECT diagnosis_json AS diagnosis_json FROM diagnoses WHERE incident_id = '$incident' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT 1 AS n, 'Model confidence' AS "Part", printf('%.2f', json_extract(diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.model')) AS "Value", 'the model’s own number (counts 40%)' AS "Meaning" FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Names what changed since the last good run', CASE json_extract(diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.explained_by_change') WHEN 1 THEN '✓ passed' WHEN 0 THEN '✗ failed' ELSE 'not recorded' END, 'evidence check (the four together count 60%)' FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Confirmed by a live check', CASE json_extract(diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.confirmed_by_check') WHEN 1 THEN '✓ passed' WHEN 0 THEN '✗ failed' ELSE 'not recorded' END, 'evidence check (the four together count 60%)' FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'The error’s own document was found', CASE json_extract(diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.exact_error_doc') WHEN 1 THEN '✓ passed' WHEN 0 THEN '✗ failed' ELSE 'not recorded' END, 'evidence check (the four together count 60%)' FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Knowledge search was strong', CASE json_extract(diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.knowledge_ok') WHEN 1 THEN '✓ passed' WHEN 0 THEN '✗ failed' ELSE 'not recorded' END, 'evidence check (the four together count 60%)' FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Calibrated confidence', printf('%.2f', coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence'))), CASE WHEN coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) >= 0.85 THEN 'auto-fix eligible (with a known fix)' WHEN coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) >= 0.7 THEN 'a person approves' ELSE 'escalated to a person' END FROM d
ORDER BY n

panels.title: Diagnosis
panels.description: The latest diagnosis of the agents.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH d AS (SELECT diagnosis_json AS j FROM diagnoses WHERE incident_id = '$incident' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT 'Root cause' AS "Item", json_extract(j, '$.root_cause.cause') AS "Detail" FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'Rests on', (SELECT group_concat(value, ', ') FROM json_each(j, '$.root_cause.evidence_refs')) FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'Proposed fix', json_extract(j, '$.resolution.summary') FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'Steps', (SELECT group_concat(value, '  →  ') FROM json_each(j, '$.resolution.steps')) FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'Automated action', coalesce('rerun_job ' || json_extract(j, '$.resolution.action.parameters'),
  'none: ' || coalesce(json_extract(j, '$.resolution.action_rejected_reason'), 'a person must act first')) FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'Known fix', coalesce(json_extract(j, '$.auto_approval.reason'), '-') FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'Knowledge cited', (SELECT group_concat(json_extract(value, '$.parent_id'), ', ') FROM json_each(j, '$.knowledge.citations')) FROM d
UNION ALL SELECT 'Rerun', CASE WHEN json_extract(j, '$.remediation.rerun_run_id') IS NULL THEN '-'
  ELSE json_extract(j, '$.remediation.rerun_run_id') || ' · ' ||
       CASE WHEN json_extract(j, '$.remediation.succeeded') THEN 'succeeded' ELSE coalesce(json_extract(j, '$.remediation.result_state'), 'running') END END FROM d

panels.title: Stages
panels.description: Each stage the ticket went through and how long it stayed there.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT at, CASE kind WHEN 'opened' THEN 'detected' ELSE replace(replace(kind, 'status:', ''), '_', ' ') END AS stage, id
  FROM incident_events WHERE incident_id = '$incident' AND (kind = 'opened' OR kind LIKE 'status:%' OR kind = 'auto_approved'))
SELECT replace(substr(at, 1, 19), 'T', ' ') AS "Time (UTC)", stage AS "Stage",
  CASE WHEN lead(at) OVER (ORDER BY id) IS NULL THEN 'now'
       ELSE printf('%.0f s', (julianday(lead(at) OVER (ORDER BY id)) - julianday(at)) * 86400) END AS "Time in stage"
FROM s ORDER BY id

panels.title: Evidence
panels.description: Collected when the failure was found: the error, the run comparison, the git diff, live checks.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT 'error' AS "Check", substr(json_extract(bundle_json, '$.error'), 1, 400) AS "Result" FROM evidence WHERE incident_id = '$incident'
UNION ALL SELECT json_extract(t.value, '$.tool'), json_extract(t.value, '$.summary')
  FROM evidence, json_each(evidence.bundle_json, '$.tool_results') t WHERE evidence.incident_id = '$incident'
UNION ALL SELECT 'not collected', p.value FROM evidence, json_each(evidence.bundle_json, '$.problems') p WHERE evidence.incident_id = '$incident'

panels.title: History
panels.description: Every step for this ticket, newest first.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT replace(substr(at, 1, 19), 'T', ' ') AS "Time (UTC)", kind AS "Step", detail AS "Detail"
FROM incident_events WHERE incident_id = '$incident' ORDER BY id DESC
